messages:
Hana Sato: Hi! Hana here, first day. My calendar is showing two 'New Hire Orientation' events at the same local time. One has the Zoom link and passcode, the other just shows 'Add conferencing'. Which should I join? I'm on JST so the time conversion looks odd. @Maya R can you help?

Maya R: Welcome Hana! :wave: Join the one with the Zoom link (that's the canonical global orientation). The duplicate is usually from different schedulers sending invites with mismatched timezone metadata. We'll get IT to normalize invites.

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Global New Hire Orientation starts at 09:00 AM ET. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.com/orientation/jun2026 Passcode: 5533. Recording will be uploaded to Confluence under /onboarding/recordings within 60 minutes post-session. If your invite lacks conferencing, check the PeopleOps calendar or reply here.

Hana Sato: Thanks. On desktop I see both events overlapping; mobile shows only the one with link. The duplicate is cluttering my calendar notifications.

IT Support: Hey Hana  quick explanation: one invite was created with organizer timezone America/New_York while another used UTC. Some calendar clients render both when timezone fields differ. Temporary user fix: delete both events and re-add from the invite that contains the Zoom link. Longer-term: we'll resend normalized invites with conferenceData and include the passcode in the description so older clients pick it up.

Tom: For macOS Calendar: turn on Time Zone Support, edit the event, set the timezone to Eastern Time, save. That usually collapses the duplicate for me.

Maya R: IT, please resend to new-hires-jun2026 and embed the Zoom URL and passcode in the event description (not just conferenceData). Also add a short recording placeholder: https://confluence.redwood.com/onboarding/recordings/2026-06.

IT Support: Will resend now with timezone=America/New_York, conferenceData/joinUrl included, and passcode duplicated in the description. New invites should arrive shortly; if duplicates persist remove both and re-add from the new invite or DM a screenshot and we'll fix it manually.

Hana Sato: New invite arrived, re-added it and the link/passcode are visible. Time converts correctly to 22:00 JST for me. Many thanks for the quick help! :thumbsup:

PeopleOps Bot: Recording will be uploaded within 60 minutes after session end. Missed it? Book a "New Hire Catch-up" with PeopleOps.
